name: ElevenLabs
description: Voice platform whose free tier covers text-to-speech and speech-to-text.
overview: ElevenLabs offers 10,000 free credits per month for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music and dubbing. Non-enterprise API data is retained and eligible for audio-model improvement by default unless the user opts out.
free_access: Commercial use requires a paid plan
notes: Free-tier audio may be used to improve models unless you opt out.
